title: CerebrA: cortical, deep and ventricular source regions
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Study original source definitions and spatial relationships in linked T1/T2 sections and three-dimensional views.

scenes.title: Left Precentral
scenes.prompt: Locate Left Precentral in the complete source sections. Compare its position with the visible source regions and the opposite hemisphere.
scenes.note: Retained source-defined categorical regions in the matching symmetric population reference. Left and right names follow the source inventory; read the paired source partitions together when discussing midline structures.
